import json
def f(g):

    for i in range(h):
        cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[r][j]!=max(set(row,key=row.count) for r in []) for _ in []] ]
    return g
# simpler: find the non-background color c and its column j (or row i); fill that line
def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    assert len(others)==1, others
    c=others[0]
    pos=[(r,c_j) for r in range(len(g)) for c_j in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c_j]==c]
    rs={p[0] for p in pos}; cs={p[1] for p in pos}
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    if len(rs)>1:
        return [[c if j==list(cs)[0] else g[r][j] for j in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    else:
        return [[g[r][j] if i==list(rs)[0] else c for i,j in [(r,j)] for r in [i]] or [[c if i==list(rs)[0] else g[r][j] for i in range(h)] for j in range(w)]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m.group(1),int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3))
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]; assert len(others)==1; c=others[0]
    pos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==c]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs={p[1] for p in pos}; rs={p[0] for p in pos}
    # if markers scattered vertically in one column -> fill column; similarly row
    if len(cs)==1 and len(rs)>1:
        j=list(cs)[0]; return [[c if j==j else v for j,v in enumerate(r)] for r in g]
    if len(rs)==1:
        i=list(rs)[0]; return [[c if i==i2 else v for i2,v in enumerate(r)] for r in g]
    return None
